primary_display_name_zh: 马库斯·图利乌斯·西塞罗

death.conversion_note: Killed in the proscriptions of the Second Triumvirate

short_description_en: Roman orator, statesman, lawyer, philosopher, and writer. Consul in 63 BCE when he suppressed the Catilinarian conspiracy; later exiled and recalled. Prolific author of speeches, philosophical works, and letters. Killed in the proscriptions of 43 BCE.
short_description_zh: 罗马演说家、政治家、律师、哲学家和作家。公元前63年任执政官期间镇压喀提林阴谋，后遭流放并被召回。著有大量演说词、哲学著作和书信。公元前43年在后三头同盟的公敌宣告中被杀。
